pages.text: Rest at a lit bonfire to $(l)heal$(), $(l)refill your Estus$() and $(l)set your respawn$().$(br2)You can travel between any bonfires you have rested at. Enemies nearby? No rest.
Plant a Coiled Sword in a $(item)Pile of Bone and Ash$() to light a new bonfire. Lost yours? Smith an iron sword with a Coiled Sword Fragment, using a fire charge as the template.
